title: tetraena propinqua subsp. migahidii
intro: Tetraena propinqua subsp. migahidii, commonly known as a shrub-like plant, is a species of plant in the Apocynaceae family. It is known for its medicinal properties, which include various health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, that may help in reducing the risk of chronic diseases. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
